<thought>All peaks between ~110 ppm and ~160 ppm correspond to aromatic carbons. The spectrum shows aromatic peaks at 137.56 ppm (2 carbons), 131.90 ppm (2 carbons), 130.00 ppm (4 carbons), and 128.40 ppm (4 carbons). Summing these gives 2 + 2 + 4 + 4 = 12 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
